title: Prepare release 0.1.1
summary: Prepare the version, release evidence and candidate checks. Diagnose slow local verification. Native package and upgrade acceptance is not a release gate.

included: Version 0.1.1, appearance source checks, local verification timing, release readiness.
excluded: Publishing a release, pushing tags, changing host security settings.

tasks.title: Diagnose verification time
tasks.acceptance: Record measured build, test and repeated-run timing. Separate evidence from suspected causes.

tasks.title: Prepare version and appearance sources
tasks.acceptance: The 0.1.1 version gate passes. Check theme sources and record remaining visual acceptance.

tasks.title: Verify the candidate
tasks.acceptance: just check and relevant generated documentation checks pass.

tasks.title: Accept native packages and upgrades
tasks.acceptance: Record downloaded package acceptance on all three platforms and the 0.1.0 upgrade result before release.

validation.result: Previous full check passed: build 34.34 seconds, Clippy 1.53 seconds; map GPU tests 54.67 seconds, schematic GPU tests 47.24 seconds, UI tests 45.24 seconds. Repeated core doc-test command: real 51.42 seconds, user 0.99 seconds, system 2.26 seconds, zero doc tests. A repeated xtask version unit test took 0.01 seconds. Most doc-test wall time is outside CPU execution. The local APFS volume is 96 percent used, and a directory-stat process entered uninterruptible wait. Storage contention is suspected; security-scanning logs did not establish a cause. Do not weaken checks or disable host security on this evidence.

validation.criterion: Version gate and candidate checks pass.
validation.result: Version gate reports version=0.1.1 and prerelease=false. Project Maintainer reported on 2026-10-10 that just check and just docs pass on the candidate, and that appearance visual acceptance passed.

validation.criterion: Native packages and upgrades receive acceptance.
validation.result: Not required before release (decision packages-not-gate). The macOS upgrade from 0.1.0 remains open as auto-update T6.

lessonsLearned: Separate process wall time from reported test execution time. A zero-test rustdoc run can still spend substantial time before test execution.

decisions.decision: Set the workspace and locked local packages to 0.1.1.
decisions.rationale: The candidate must pass the same version gate used by the release workflow.
decisions.consequences: Version gate now reports version=0.1.1 and prerelease=false. This does not publish a tag or prove native package acceptance.

decisions.decision: Native package and upgrade acceptance is not a hard gate for 0.1.1.
decisions.rationale: Project Maintainer decision on 2026-10-10. The real upgrade path can only be exercised after a newer release exists.
decisions.consequences: T4 is cancelled. Package problems found after release are fixed in a later patch release; auto-update T6 keeps the macOS upgrade check open.

outcome: The 0.1.1 candidate is versioned and verified. Publishing the tag remains a Project Maintainer action outside this plan.
